editorial.blurb: Kama brings contemporary Indian dining to Wicker Park with a sophisticated lounge-like setting and inventive cocktails that complement its modern takes on traditional flavors.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the crispy chili potatoes—they're the standout dish with their perfect textural contrast and sweet-spicy balance. Pair with the spicy chicken tikka masala and garlic naan for a complete experience.
